task: Add Zen Browser recognition to the existing concise taskbar title utility in orbit-shell/utils/WindowTitle.js. Recognize zen, zen-browser, and app.zen_browser.zen as browsers. Preserve existing browser, code-editor and ordinary application behavior. Make the smallest surgical edit; no unrelated refactors.
acceptance: All three Zen identities produce contextual browser labels. Firefox and non-browser labels remain unchanged. New Tab remains the application name.
test_commands: const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),assert=require('assert'); const ctx={};vm.createContext(ctx);vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync('orbit-shell/utils/WindowTitle.js','utf8').replace(/^\.pragma library\s*/,'') ,ctx);for(const id of ['zen','zen-browser','app.zen_browser.zen'])assert.strictEqual(ctx.conciseTitle('Documentation — Local AI — Zen Browser','Zen Browser',id),'Zen Browser - Local AI',id);assert.strictEqual(ctx.conciseTitle('Documentation — Mozilla Firefox','Mozilla Firefox','firefox'),'Mozilla Firefox - Documentation');assert.strictEqual(ctx.conciseTitle('Untitled — Editor','Editor','plain-editor'),'Editor — Untitled');assert.strictEqual(ctx.conciseTitle('New Tab — Zen Browser','Zen Browser','zen-browser'),'Zen Browser');console.log('PASS: Zen identities, Firefox regression, non-browser regression, new tab');
